chapter: Ben Webster, Tatum and Los Angeles scene
title: George Mraz and the nickname Bounce
summary: He explains his nickname for bassist George Mraz.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: I understand that my, my favorite around here... My favorite is George Mraz. I understand he's having trouble with his left hand. You know, he studied violin for twelve years. And he's got tendinitis or something in his left hand. And that's not good! That's not good at all. He should watch it. Because he is fantastic!
Boy! I call him Bounce. You know why.
Yeah, I do. But I think you might as well put it on record.
Well, he's from Czechoslovakia, and in the
musicians' lingo, when they say a guy is "ba-a-ad," that means he's good. So I call him Bounce because he's a ba-ad Czech. A lot of people call him Bounce.
